items.headline: European tech buyers add digital sovereignty to cyber shopping list
items.summary: Sales from EU HQ'd vendor rocket in two years. The Trump affect? Yes but NIS2 and DORA are factors too.

items.headline: Commission approves €286 million German State aid to port of Hamburg
items.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 13 Nov 2026 The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, two €143 million German measures to support infrastructure works in the port of Hamburg. The measures concern two distinct infrastructure projects, one at the Salzgitter quay and one at the Steinwerder quay

items.headline: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
items.summary: Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans, even as delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model
